svg.title: Waveshare RP2350-CAN board, Osoyoo screw-terminal breakout board
svg.desc: Illustration of the RP2350-CAN board in the Osoyoo breakout board: 20 screw terminals on each long edge, beside each a servo plug point with the pins S, V and G, a jumper for 3.3 V or 5 V on V, CAN screw terminal on the module.
